result.topic_en: Calculations on gas dynamics for a polytropic gas: the enthalpy integral, jump (shock) conditions relating pressures, densities and velocities on both sides of a discontinuity, and a reduction of the steady two-dimensional flow equations to a second-order equation for a stream function σ.
result.transcription:
[-$f$-]
$\int \varphi(\varrho)\,\partial\log\varrho + \frac{u^2}{2} = \frac{k}{k-1}\frac{p}{\varrho} + \frac{u^2}{2}$
$\left(\frac{u_1^2}{2}(k-1) + \frac{p_1}{\varrho_1} + \frac{u_1 p_1}{v_1\varrho_1}(k-1) - \qquad\right) = 0$
$\left((k-1)\frac{u_1^2}{2} + k\frac{p_1}{\varrho_1} - \qquad\right) + 1-k\left(\frac{p_1}{\varrho_1} + \frac{u_1 p_1}{v_1\varrho_1}\right)$
$2\left(p_1(u_1+v_1) - p_2(u_2+v_2)\right) = (p_1+p_2)\,2(v_1-v_2) + (u_1+u_2+v_1+v_2)(p_1-p_2)$
$= v_1\varrho_1\,(v_1-v_2)\left(\left(\frac{2}{k}-1\right)(v_1+v_2) - (u_1+u_2)\right)$
$p_1 - p_2 = v_1\varrho_1(v_2-v_1)$
$p_1 + p_2 = \frac{1}{k}v_1\varrho_1(v_1+v_2)$
[-$p_1$-] $\frac{2p_1}{v_1\varrho_1} = v_2\left(\frac{1}{k}+1\right) - v_1\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)$
$\frac{2p_2}{v_2\varrho_2} = v_1\left(\frac{1}{k}+1\right) - v_2\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)$
$2\frac{p_2}{\varrho_2} + v_2^2\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right) = v_1v_2\left(1+\frac{1}{k}\right) = 2\frac{p_1}{\varrho_1} + v_1^2\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)$
$\partial_\varrho\frac{\partial\log p}{\partial\varrho} = k\,\partial\log\varrho$
$d_\varrho\frac{p}{\varrho} = \frac{p}{\varrho}\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)\frac{\partial\log p}{\partial\varrho}\,d\varrho$
$d_\varrho\frac{p}{\varrho} = \frac{p}{\varrho}\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)$ [-$d\log p$-] $\frac{d_\varrho p}{\varrho}$
$\frac{dp}{\varrho} + \omega\,d\omega = (v\,dx - u\,dy)\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right) = d\sigma\,\frac{1}{\varrho}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)$ [-$=\frac{\partial ...}{\varrho\,\partial\sigma}$-]
$= -\frac{1}{(k-1)}\frac{d_\sigma p}{\varrho}$
$\frac{dp}{\varrho}\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right) + \omega\,d\omega\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right) = -\frac{\partial\frac{p}{\varrho}}{\partial\sigma}\partial\sigma$
[-$\frac{dp}{\varrho}(1-\frac{1}{k})$-] $\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)\left(\frac{dp}{\varrho} + \omega\,d\omega\right) = \left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)\frac{dp}{\varrho} - d_\sigma\frac{p}{\varrho}$
$= -\frac{1}{k}\frac{d_\sigma p}{\varrho}$
[-$=\frac{\partial p}{\partial\sigma}\frac{1}{\varrho(1-\frac{1}{k})}d\sigma$-]
[-$\frac{dp}{d\varrho}\frac{d\varrho}{\varrho}$-]
$\omega = \frac{\omega'}{\varrho}$
$d_\varrho\frac{p}{\varrho} + \frac{\omega' d\omega'}{\varrho^2} - \frac{\omega'^2}{\varrho^2}d\log\varrho + d_\sigma\frac{p}{\varrho} = 0$
$\frac{p}{\varrho}(d_\varrho\log p - d\log\varrho) = (k-1)\frac{p}{\varrho}\,d\log\varrho$
$\left(\frac{\omega'^2}{\varrho^2} - (k-1)\frac{p}{\varrho}\right)d\log\varrho = \frac{\omega' d\omega'}{\varrho^2} + d_\sigma\frac{p}{\varrho}$
$-\frac{1}{k-1}\frac{\frac{\partial p}{\partial\sigma}}{\varrho} = \frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x}}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial y}}{\partial y} = -\frac{1}{\varrho^2}\left(\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial y}\right) + \frac{1}{\varrho^2}\left(\frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial y^2}\right)$
$(\omega'^2 - (k-1)p\varrho)\,d\log\varrho = \omega' d\omega' + d_\sigma p\varrho$
$(\omega'^2 - (k-1)p\varrho)\left(\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial y}\right) = \omega'\left(\frac{\partial\omega'}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\omega'}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial y}\right) + \frac{\partial p\varrho}{\partial\sigma}\omega'^2$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial y^2}\right)(\omega'^2 - (k-1)p\varrho) + \omega'\left(\frac{\partial\omega'}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\omega'}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial y}\right) = \omega'^2\frac{\partial p\varrho}{\partial\sigma} + (\omega'^2 - (k-1)p\varrho)\frac{1}{k-1}\frac{\partial p\varrho}{\partial\sigma}$
[-$x = x'\quad \varrho y = y'$-]
[-$dx = x\,d\varrho$-]
[-$dx' = \varrho\,dx + x\,d\varrho$-]
$\frac{2p_2}{v_1\varrho_1}\left(1+\frac{1}{k}\right) = v_1\left(1+\frac{1}{k}\right)^2 - v_1\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)^2 - \frac{2p_1}{v_1\varrho_1}\left(1-\frac{1}{k}\right)$

methods.what: Enthalpy integral (Bernoulli function) for polytropic gas
Momentum jump condition across a discontinuity
Derived shock relations for pressure-density ratios on each side
Crocco-type relation linking Bernoulli variation, vorticity and stream function
methods.quote: $\frac{dp}{\varrho} + \omega\,d\omega = (v\,dx - u\,dy)\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right) = d\sigma\,\frac{1}{\varrho}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)$

methods.what: Second-order PDE for stream function σ of steady compressible rotational flow
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2\sigma}{\partial y^2}\right)(\omega'^2 - (k-1)p\varrho) + \omega'\left(\frac{\partial\omega'}{\partial x}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial\omega'}{\partial y}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial y}\right) = \omega'^2\frac{\partial p\varrho}{\partial\sigma} + (\omega'^2 - (k-1)p\varrho)\frac{1}{k-1}\frac{\partial p\varrho}{\partial\sigma}$
